name: CreateResourceGroup

parameters.help_en: The name of the general-purpose resource group. It must be up to 128 characters long, start with a letter, and contain only letters, digits, and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh: 创建通用资源组的名称，必须以字母开头，可包含字母、数字、下划线（_），最多128个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.example: Create a serverless resource group for common tasks
parameters.help_en: The remark for the general-purpose resource group. It can be up to 128 characters long and can contain letters, Chinese characters, digits, and underscores (\_)
parameters.help_zh: 创建通用资源组的备注，可包含字母、中文、数字、下划线（_），最多128个字符
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en: The billing method of the resource group. `PrePaid` indicates subscription, and `PostPaid` indicates pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 资源组的付费类型，PrePaid代表包年包月，PostPaid代表按量付费
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en: The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values: `Month` and `Year`
parameters.help_zh: 付费时长单位，Month代表包月，Year代表包年
parameters.name: payment_duration_unit

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal for the subscription
parameters.name: auto_renew_enabled

parameters.help_en: The specification of the resource group, in CUs. This parameter is required when `PaymentType` is set to `PrePaid`
parameters.help_zh: 资源组规格,单位CU，当资源组付费模式为PrePaid时，必填
parameters.name: spec

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to be bound by default
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to be bound by default
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request
parameters.help_zh: 客户端幂等性标识，用于保证创建通用资源组操作的幂等性
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: aliyun_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of Alibaba Cloud tags
parameters.name: aliyun_resource_tags
